description: Debug log. Locally on the console with time stamp, move number and level; on the server to stderr, stored with a size limit and visible only to owner and admin. The discipline sets a maximum level for the server.

functions.name: set_level
functions.description: Sets the minimum level written. The server maximum of the discipline still applies.

functions.name: level
functions.description: Current minimum level. The start value comes from the command line or environment, default INFO.

functions.name: is_enabled
functions.description: Whether a message at that level would be written; avoids building expensive messages.
